verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair axis for an observability platform, but the pack never documents user-configurable automations that act autonomously in the background. The relevant items (Monitors, Watchdog, Bits AI, Kubernetes Autoscaling) appear only as page titles with no content showing autonomous or scheduled automations. Monitors and alerting are an adjacent capability, not autonomous automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
